body:
First of Id like to say that I've had many experience with chemicals, these include steroids, amphetamines, opiates, you name it I've probably tried it.
9:00
Started dosing with my 2 lovely lady friends who I will call z and g, also psychedelic troopers. We started out taking some etizolam to prevent the come up from making us uneasy before we got on the boat which we got on 30 mins later.
11:00 We started feeling the strong effects of the etizolam and felt it would be a great time to pop a 1200ug tab of 25c. Interestingly enough I brought more than 20 tabs assuming other people would have been willing to try it. Thought it didnt seem to be the case.
11:30 something is going on, feelings of coincidence and serandipity seem to roll in and we start come in. Visuals too, Lots of patterns that are impossible to draw.
Now this is where everything changed.
12:00 The etizolam potentiated the effects of the 25. I had HD vision and immense relaxation. This had to be one of my most favorite drug combinations I have every tried.
2:00 We pop more 2x etizolam and  2x 25c to keep the good feelings rolling.
3:00 Is it just me? Or can you drink a fuckton on this combination? We took down a 24 pack of beer which excelled the effect. It
4:00 we eventually reach an island. Crystal blue waters, palm trees and such. Z and G and I just went crazy and jumped off from the top of the yacht, swam 500 meters to the island and sat on the beach with smiles on our faces. We stayed there for 2 hours swimming with fish and chilling with other folks on the island.
7:00
Sadly we had to leave the island as our rental time for the yacht was up. We decided to relax on the tabs and wait until we got home to decide what was next. The rest of the boat ride was like a calm mdma trip, we spoke about each other problems, told each other stories and even shed a few tears.
But this is where it got weird.
At 10 pm we arrived home, Z was complainig about feeling horney. Didnt blame her since all the dudes on the boat. G on the other hand felt the same. So since we were all single and I felt obligated, we decided to have a fail of the threesome.
Mid way fucking Z I lost my hard on because well, she didnt rock my lustful world as much G. Don't want to sound like a total douche but she did everything possible to make sex during a trip strange. G on the other hand was loving it and had a great time.
After all this we fell asleep and I woke up to a handjob, and a fucking amazing comedown.
I
liked this combination but instead of using 25c would use AL-LAD or normal LSD. 25c has given me hppd, its minor but I cant stare at lines without having my vision distort. Though I'm a positive guy and enjoy the world looking weird.
